Everything here about "Electric 10s" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through October 18.
2772.headline: How much has sold

2773.body:
"Sugar Skull Cash" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $100,000 was claimed earlier this week. Unsold tickets still hold one of the original four. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

Every line of Sugar Skull Cash's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2773.headline: Someone claimed a $100,000 prize

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" has 787,288 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50,000 prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "The Price is Right™" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2774.headline: A close look at the prizes

2775.body:
"Casino 7s" has four of four top prizes left and is still new. Only a small slice of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

If you play "Casino 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
